IC1: Are at least 18 years of age
IC2: Demonstrate a positive cough stress test during complex multi-channel urodynamic testing
IC3: Demonstrate impact of stress urinary incontinence on quality of life questionnaire
IC4: Are able to comprehend and sign a written informed consent
IC5: Understand and are willing to comply with the study requirements, including agreeing to be available for the follow-up evaluations
IC6: Are psychologically stable and suitable for interventions determined by the investigator
IC7: Are ambulatory and able to use a toilet independently
